Fortsätt utforska.';light=.85;document.querySelector('#light').textContent='Ljus: dag';}else if(Math.hypot(player.x-78,player.z-86)<24){document.querySelector('#quest').textContent='Eiffeltornet står nu i spelet och området runt det har fått mer detaljer.';}else if(Math.hypot(player.x+18,player.z-36)<20||Math.hypot(player.x-78,player.z-86)<34){document.querySelector('#quest').textContent='Gräs, grus och något som rör sig i vegetationen gör platsen mer levande.';}else document.querySelector('#quest').textContent=count===3?'Återvänd till tornet och aktivera det.':near?'Relik funnen. Sök nästa ljus.':'Sök nära de tre stora kristallerna.';}
function update(dt){if(!active||paused){lift.update(0,active,paused);jumpWanted=useWanted=false;return;}if(lift.aboard){if(useWanted)lift.interact();useWanted=false;lift.update(dt,active,paused);return;}let sx=(keys.KeyD?1:0)-(keys.KeyA?1:0)+stick.x,fw=(keys.KeyW||keys.ArrowUp?1:0)-(keys.KeyS||keys.ArrowDown?1:0)-stick.y;player.yaw+=((keys.ArrowLeft?1:0)-(keys.ArrowRight?1:0))*dt*1.8;let pads=[];try{pads=Array.from(navigator.getGamepads?.()||[])}catch{}let pad=pads.find(p=>p?.connected),pu=false,pj=false;if(pad){const axis=i=>Math.abs(pad.axes[i]||0)>.16?pad.axes[i]:0;sx+=axis(0);fw-=axis(1);player.yaw-=axis(2)*dt*2;player.pitch=Math.max(-1.25,Math.min(1.25,player.pitch-axis(3)*dt*1.5));pj=!!pad.buttons[0]?.pressed;pu=!!pad.buttons[2]?.pressed;if(pj&&!previousJump)jumpWanted=true;if(pu&&!previousUse)useWanted=true;}previousUse=pu;previousJump=pj;const len=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(sx,fw)),speed=(keys.ShiftLeft?12:7)*dt;let dx=(Math.cos(player.yaw)*sx-Math.sin(player.yaw)*fw)/len*speed,dz=(-Math.sin(player.yaw)*sx-Math.cos(player.yaw)*fw)/len*speed;let steps=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(dx,dz)/.15));for(let i=0;i<steps;i++){if(canMove(player.x+dx/steps,player.z))player.x+=dx/steps;if(canMove(player.x,player.z+dz/steps))player.z+=dz/steps;}let ground=height(player.x,player.z)+1.7;if(jumpWanted&&player.y<=ground+.12)player.vy=6;jumpWanted=false;player.vy-=17*dt;player.y+=player.vy*dt;if(player.y<ground){player.y=ground;player.vy=0;}if(useWanted)interact();useWanted=false;const target=relics.filter(r=>!r.got).sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-player.x,a.z-player.z)-Math.hypot(b.x-player.x,b.z-player.z))[0];document.querySelector('#hint').textContent=target?target.name+' · '+Math.round(Math.hypot(target.x-player.x,target.z-player.z))+' m · E / Använd nära kristallen':won?'Världen är din att utforska.':'Tornet · '+Math.round(Math.hypot(player.x-5,player.z+12))+' m · E / Använd';lift.update(dt,active,paused);}
function render(){const a=canvas.width/canvas.height,f=1/Math.tan(Math.PI/6),near=.1,far=500,proj=new Float32Array([f/a,0,0,0,0,f,0,0,0,0,(far+near)/(near-far),-1,0,0,2*far*near/(near-far),0]);const cy=Math.cos(player.yaw),sy=Math.sin(player.yaw),cp=Math.cos(player.pitch),sp=Math.sin(player.pitch),right=[cy,0,-sy],up=[sy*sp,cp,cy*sp],back=[sy*cp,-sp,cy*cp],eye=[player.x,player.y,player.z],dot=v=>v.reduce((s,x,i)=>s+x*eye[i],0);const view=new Float32Array([right[0],up[0],back[0],0,right[1],up[1],back[1],0,right[2],up[2],back[2],0,-dot(right),-dot(up),-dot(back),1]);gl.clearColor(0,0,0,0);gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT|gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);gl.uniformMatrix4fv(loc.uVP,false,multiply(proj,view));gl.uniform3fv(loc.uEye,eye);gl.uniform1f(loc.uTime,elapsed);gl.uniform1f(loc.uLight,light);gl.uniform1f(loc.uLiftOffset,lift.offset);gl.uniform1f(loc.uSpruceReady,spruceReady);gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,verts.length/12);}
function frame(t){try{let dt=Math.min(.04,(t-last)/1000||0);last=t;if(!paused)elapsed+=dt;update(dt);window.__askAtmos?.update(elapsed,Math.hypot(player.x+48,player.z-58)<54);render();if(!ready){ready=true;dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('duoforge-game-started'));}raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);}catch(e){console.error('Asklandet WebGL render:',e);cleanups.forEach(fn=>fn());window.__asklandetSoft3D('WebGL-fel – bytte automatiskt till fungerande 3D-perspektiv');}}raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
on(canvas,'webglcontextlost',e=>{e.preventDefault();cancelAnimationFrame(raf);cleanups.forEach(fn=>fn());window.__asklandetSoft3D('WebGL förlorade grafikkontexten – spelet fortsätter i kompatibelt 3D-läge');});on(window,'pagehide',()=>{cancelAnimationFrame(raf);cleanups.forEach(fn=>fn());gl.deleteBuffer(buffer);gl.deleteTexture(tex);spruceTex.forEach(t=>gl.deleteTexture(t));gl.deleteProgram(program)});
})();
}catch(e){console.error('Asklandet 3D-start:',e);window.__asklandetSoft3D('3D-start reparerades automatiskt');}
}</script></html>
